title: Identities
description: Credentials leased to crawler nodes: lifecycle state, health and manual operations
noNamespace: Select a namespace to see its identities.

empty.title: No identities yet
empty.description: Import identities from JSON Lines or CSV to start scheduling.
empty.filteredDescription: No identity matches the current filters. Adjust or reset them.

fields.noTypes: No identity types for this site

filters.scoreOrder: Min score must not exceed max score.

operationHints.cooldown: Pauses leasing for a while, for the whole site or one endpoint group.
operationHints.ban: Removes the identities from scheduling until the ban ends; "permanent" never ends.
operationHints.unban: Lifts the ban; the identities become schedulable again.
operationHints.quarantine: Sets the identities aside for review; an empty duration uses the action policy default.
operationHints.expire: Marks the credentials as expired so a refresh service can renew them.
operationHints.disable: Stops scheduling until the identities are enabled again.
operationHints.archive: Retires the identities. They are hidden from lists and never scheduled until restored.
operationHints.restore: Brings retired identities back to pending.
operationHints.activate: Moves pending or expired identities to active without waiting for a successful probe.
operationHints.reset_stats: Resets health scores and failure streaks.

scopeHints.all: Resets scores and streaks at the site and every endpoint group.
scopeHints.identity_site: Applies to every endpoint group of the site.
scopeHints.identity_endpoint: Applies only to the selected endpoint group.

durationHints.ban: For example 7d, or choose Permanent from the presets.
durationHints.quarantine: Leave empty to use the action policy default.

operation.resetHealth: Also reset health scores to the baseline
operation.reasonHint: Recorded in state events and the audit log.

errors.durationPositive: The duration must be greater than zero.

bulk.menuHeading: Apply to every identity matching the filter
bulk.title: {{operation}} all matching identities
bulk.description: The operation applies to every identity matching the current filter, not only this page. Preview the count first.
bulk.noFilters: No filter is active: this applies to every non-retired identity in the namespace.
bulk.noMatches: No identity matches the current filter.
bulk.confirmDescription: Identities matching the filter when the operation runs are affected; the count may have changed since the preview.

import.title: Import identities
import.description: Upload or paste JSON Lines or CSV for one identity type. Validate with a dry run, then import.

formatHints.jsonl: One JSON object per line; reserved keys _account, _region, _tags and _labels.
formatHints.csv: Header row of field names; reserved columns _account, _region and _tags (separated by ;).

modeHints.upsert: Identities with the same unique key receive a new payload version.
modeHints.create_only: Identities with an existing unique key are skipped.

import.fileTooLarge: The file is {{size}}; the limit is {{max}}.
import.fileReadFailed: The file could not be read.
import.dryRunFirst: Run a dry run with the current input first.
import.toastValidated: Dry run passed: {{created}} to create, {{updated}} to update, {{unchanged}} unchanged
import.toastValidatedWithFailures: Dry run finished with {{failed}} rejected rows

newIdentity.title: New identity
newIdentity.description: Create one identity from the fields of its type. The row goes through the same import path as a file, so it is normalized, deduplicated and activated by the same rules.
newIdentity.noFields: This identity type declares no payload fields.
newIdentity.updated: An identity with the same unique key already existed; its payload was replaced.
newIdentity.unchanged: An identity with the same unique key and payload already exists; nothing changed.

hints.cookie_map: A Cookie header, an object of names to values, or a browser export array.
hints.secret_ref: A namespace-relative vault path, not the secret itself.

errors.reserved: This field name is reserved by the import format and cannot be filled in here.

revert.title: Revert automatic actions
revert.description: Undo bans, quarantines, expirations and cooldowns recorded by rules, for example after a rule misfired.
revert.policyIdHint: Action policy ID; empty matches any policy.
revert.rangeOrder: The start must be before the end.
revert.dryRunFirst: Run a dry run with the current input first.
revert.previewTitle: Dry run: identities that would be reverted
revert.stale: Inputs changed since the dry run
revert.confirmDescription: Identities still carrying a reverted ban, quarantine or expiry go back to pending; reverted cooldowns are cleared. This is recorded in the audit log.
revert.toastPreview_one: Dry run: {{count}} identity would be reverted
revert.toastPreview_other: Dry run: {{count}} identities would be reverted

detail.notFoundDescription: Identity {{id}} does not exist or is not accessible in this namespace.

metadata.title: Edit attributes
metadata.description: Only changed attributes are saved. The payload is not affected.
metadata.accountHint: External reference of the account; created when missing. Clear it to detach the account.

labels.keyTooLong: Label keys have at most {{keyMax}} characters.
labels.valueTooLong: Label values have at most {{valueMax}} characters.

payload.title: Payload
payload.maskedHint: Sensitive fields are masked. Revealing is audited.
payload.revealedHint: Clear-text payload; it is masked again automatically.
payload.revealDescription: Sensitive fields are shown in clear text for {{seconds}} seconds. The reveal is recorded in the audit log.
payload.revealRefused: The server returned the masked payload: revealing requires identity:reveal on this site and a readable payload.
payload.editDescription: The JSON object is validated against the identity type schema and stored as version {{version}}.
payload.editMaskedWarning: The payload is masked. Reveal it first or replace every masked value (••••); masked values cannot be saved.
payload.confirmDescription: Active, pending, quarantined and expired identities return to pending for re-validation (or active for types with immediate activation) and their health scores reset. Banned, disabled and retired identities keep their state.

errors.notObject: The payload must be a JSON object.
errors.masked: Replace the masked values (••••) before saving.

hot.siteDescription: Scheduler state in Redis at the site level.
hot.notPresent: The identity is not materialized in the hot state, so it is not schedulable until the next rebuild or state change.
hot.groupsDescription: Health and availability of this identity per endpoint group.
hot.noGroupsDescription: The identity has not been leased or observed on any endpoint group yet.

risk.title: Recent risk events
risk.description: Non-success reports of this identity in the last 24 hours.
risk.empty: No risk events in the last 24 hours
